en: O Hawaiʻi, O sands of my birth,
I rejoice in your heavenly blessings,
Be happy, O youth of Hawaiʻi here,
From the gentle breezes blowing here
your beloved native people, O Hawaiʻi,
of the wondrous shining things from above,
notes: line 1.1: 'one hānau', the sands of one's birth, one's birthplace.
line 1.3: 'pono lani', heavenly blessings or bounties; 'pono' is also righteousness.
line 3.1: 'kini lani', heavenly (or chiefly) multitudes: 'lani' is heaven and also the high chiefs.
